description: Defines PRACH (Physical Random Access Channel) configuration structures, enums, constants, and a function for retrieving configurations, related to 3GPP 5G NR specifications.

classes.name: ssb_per_rach_occasions
classes.description: Enumeration representing the number of SSBs per RACH occasion, with values from 1/8 to 16.

classes.name: prach_configuration
classes.description: Structure holding PRACH configuration parameters such as format, SFN period, slots, starting symbol, and duration.

methods.name: ssb_per_rach_occ_to_float
methods.description: Converts an ssb_per_rach_occasions enum value to a float representing the ratio.

methods.name: prach_configuration_get
methods.description: Retrieves a PRACH configuration based on frequency range, duplex mode, and configuration index.
